name: Lakewood Center
summary: Established mall provides well-known retail shops, restaurants & department stores, plus a theater.
description: Lakewood Center is a destination shopping center conveniently located near Long Beach, CA, just off the 91, 605, and 405 freeways at Lakewood Blvd and Del Amo Blvd. Featuring over 225 retailers including major department stores like Macy's and JCPenney, big-box anchors like Target, Home Depot, and Costco, and popular brands like Victoria's Secret, H&M, and Best Buy, the center also offers diverse dining options from California Pizza Kitchen to Dave's Hot Chicken, plus entertainment including a 16-screen Starlight Cinemas and Round One.
demographics: Lakewood Center serves a diverse, middle-class demographic in the Southeast Los Angeles County area, drawing families and value-conscious shoppers from Lakewood, Long Beach, and surrounding communities. The trade area consists primarily of working and middle-class households with mixed age demographics, including young families and established homeowners seeking convenient access to everyday essentials and entertainment. Visitors prioritize practical shopping with a mix of department stores, big-box retailers, and affordable dining options, reflecting a mainstream consumer base focused on value and convenience rather than luxury shopping experiences.
